description: This file defines an abstract class 'ChannelOwner' that manages communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation within the Playwright core library. It includes methods for managing event listeners, creating proxy channels, wrapping API calls with tracing, and disposing of resources.

classes.name: ChannelOwner
classes.description: An abstract class managing communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation for Playwright's internal architecture.

methods.name: _setEventToSubscriptionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping between event names and subscription protocol events.

methods.name: _updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription status for a given event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'on' to manage subscription updates when listeners are added.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'addListener' to manage subscription updates.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'prependListener' to manage subscription updates.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'off' to manage subscription updates when listeners are removed.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'removeListener' to manage subscription updates.

methods.name: _adopt
methods.description: Adopts a child ChannelOwner, updating parent-child relationships.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the ChannelOwner, cleaning up references and disposing children.

methods.name: _debugScopeState
methods.description: Returns a debug state representing the object and its children.

methods.name: _validatorToWireContext
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorContext for wire protocol validation.

methods.name: _createChannel
methods.description: Creates a proxy channel with validation and instrumentation.

methods.name: _wrapApiCall
methods.description: Wraps API calls with tracing, error handling, and instrumentation.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON serialization to prevent issues with object printing.
